title.en: CHAP 146 O1 PASSPORTS VISA EXEMPTION ORDER

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order.

Any person being a citizen of any of the countries specified in Schedule 1 who immediately before 14th December 1983. being the date of commencement of the Act. was allowed to enter Brunei Darussalam without being required to have a valid visa for Brunei Darussalam shall by virtue of this Order and subject to the provisions of the l~nmigration Act (Chapter 17) and any regulations made thereunder continue to be allowed to enter Brunei Darussalam without a visa until otherwise provided.

Any person who is a citizen of any of the countries specified in Schedule 2 shall be exempted from the provisions of section 3(1) relating to visa requirements provided he enters Brunei Darussalam by air and disembarks at the Brunei International Airport and satisfies the Controller of lmmigration that he has a confirmed return or confirmed outward passage. Schedule 3

(I) Any person who is a citizen of any of the countries specified in Schedule 3 shall be exempted from the provisions of section 3(1) relating to visa requirements provided he complies with such conditions as the Controller of lmmigration may impose in accordance with the directions of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang DiPertuan.

(2) For the purposes of Schedule 3, "a citizen of the United Kingdoin" (or "British citizen") does not include a person who holds a passport describing the holder thereof as "British Overseas Citizen" or "British Dependent Territories Citizen". 6 CAP. 146,O 1 Passports Schedule 4

Any person who is a citizen of any of the countries specified in Schedule 4 and who holds a valid diplomatic or official passport and enters Brunei Darussalam on official business shall be exempted from the provisions of section 3(1) relating to visa requirements provided he complies with such conditions as the Controller of lmmigration may impose in accordance with the directions of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.
